capabilities: Chat with configurable AI models in a main-tab homepage with streaming replies and history
Attach current notes, selections, web pages and images to conversations
Retrieve vault notes via local keyword search across chosen knowledge bases
Organize conversations or notes into wiki card drafts and folder Index.md files
Write results back as new, appended or rewritten notes after a confirmation preview
extras: Closed-source distribution; the license forbids modifying and redistributing the source. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installation via BRAT or manual file copy is documented alongside the community plugin store.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI chat, and sidebar-based chat plugins squeeze conversations into a narrow pane with no easy way to save results back into notes.

requires.name: User-arranged model service and its usage fees

summary: AI chat plugin that turns new tabs into a chat homepage, with note, web and image context, local keyword retrieval, and previewed write-back to notes.
